STUDIO V Architecture is an award winning, design driven studio-based architectural and urban practice located in New York City. Our practice is dedicated to creating innovative contemporary architecture and the reinvention of the 21st century city.
We are seeking creative, talented designers and innovators with outstanding experience, academic credentials, design skills, and technical knowledge to turn ideas into reality.

Our Studio engages a diverse clientele and an extraordinary range of projects types. We foster an open studio environment and culture that shares, discusses and tests ideas. Our work is focused on contemporary expressions of form, materials, and fabrication to create new expressions in the urban landscape.
STUDIO V Architecture is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a participant in the E-verify program. This is a full-time position and salary range is $74,000-$91,000 depending on skills and relevant experience. Please email a pdf of your cover letter, resume and work samples to [email protected]
